title: Time-boxed sequence-core comparison under one frozen protocol

scope.data: frozen v1 artifacts, not rebuilt and not extended

selected.reason: tied with LSTM inside the 0.0007 seed spread and 27% cheaper to train; ahead of the transformer and the TCN by 5x and 11x that spread

budget.bias: this budget is the GRU's own selected configuration, so the comparison favours it. At epoch 18 the transformer's train-minus-validation gap was still negative while the GRU's had reached +0.0464 by epoch 25: the GRU was memorising, the transformer had not finished learning.

claim: under the GRU's budget the GRU is no worse than any alternative and cheaper than the one that ties it. NOT 'the GRU is the best architecture'.
